This is a metered RydeTAXI trip, so extra kilometres run on the meter and route-deviation refunds are measured per kilometre rather than by a fixed quote [F8][RD-2]. [F9], and the rider answered at 12:47 "Sure, go ahead." [F10]. That rider message is timestamped before the segment started at 12:49 and the chat record is complete, both messages timestamped [F11], so this is a named-road authorisation read in context. The rider's words "go ahead" adopt the driver's named route, and the segment is the deviation made to take that route; the exemption applies to the earlier segment the authorisation was given for [F9][F10][RD-5]. There is no threat, intimidation, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation anywhere in them [F9][F10][F12] — finding is "none" [RD-1 conditions aside, SAFE-1 screen applied].
